title: Love at first slide

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Let a headline borrow product language so the campaign’s voice feels connected to how people interact.
strategic_value: The slide pun and message bubbles can tie an emotional scene to Instagram’s conversational experience.
demonstration: White Love at first slide lettering sits above a portrait, with two pink chat-style bubbles across the image.
practical_value: Pair a verbal product reference with restrained interface cues so the message remains human.

content_islands.name: Headline
content_islands.spec: Stack the white title at the top and use a heart-like form within Love.

content_islands.name: Portrait and chat cues
content_islands.spec: Let the portrait fill the canvas and place the pink bubbles beside the people.

reference_purposes.Expression: The headline treatment and pink bubbles give the photograph a conversational tone.
reference_purposes.Application: The composition applies product-like cues to a campaign message.
